summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Banco Bradesco S.A., a Brazilian foreign private issuer, reporting insider share transactions by board members and executive officers for June 2026. The filing lists opening and closing balances of common and non-voting shares held by the controller group and related parties, along with a monthly record of buy and sell trades executed on the Brazilian exchange. No special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or management change is present. The disclosure is a standard periodic report of beneficial ownership changes, not a corporate action requiring special-situations classification.
